Container.Name: Tune
Container.Overview: Tune is a self-hosted multi-room music server. It indexes your local library (FLAC, DSD...), brings in Qobuz, Tidal and Deezer, and plays bit-perfect to DLNA/UPnP renderers, Chromecast, AirPlay and Squeezebox players from a web interface on port 8888. Host networking is required for device discovery.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Tune database, settings and artwork cache.

Config.Description: Scan the library when the container starts.
